title: Clark–Ismail coefficient-positivity conjecture for the power series of $g_j$
statement:
For $j>1$, define

$$
g_j(v)=\left(\frac{1-\operatorname{e}^{-v}}{v}\right)^{j+1}\operatorname{e}^{jv}\frac{\operatorname{d}^j}{\operatorname{d}v^j}\left(\frac{v^j}{1-\operatorname{e}^{-v}}\right).
$$
 Suppose that $g_j$ has the power-series expansion

$$
g_j(v)=\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\gamma(j,k)v^k.
$$

**Clark–Ismail's coefficient-positivity conjecture.** Then $\gamma(j,k)\ge0$ for all $j>1$ and $k\ge0$. This is a coefficientwise strengthening of the positivity question for $g_j$ and was posed alongside the preceding conjecture; the source does not specify whether it has been resolved.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.12697

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2023).
source_name: Yan-Fang Li, Dongkyu Lim and Feng Qi, “Closed-form formulas, determinantal expressions, recursive relations, power series, and special values of several functions used in Clark–Ismail's two conjectures”, arXiv:2310.12697 (2023).
